title: Interview of the C-130 pilot in Bozeman for True Legends
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Interview of the C-130 pilot in Bozeman for True Legends, about 2010s at Bozeman, Montana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we flew him out to Boseman, Montana, and we interviewed him, Steve and I.

plain: A filmmaker named Tim Alberino says that sometime in the 2010s, he and a colleague named Steve Quayle flew a pilot of a C-130, a large military cargo plane, out to Bozeman, Montana, to interview him for their project True Legends. He tells this to podcast host Jesse Michels, in a conversation about the claim that a 12-foot giant was captured in Afghanistan. If the pilot's account holds up, it would back up that claim from someone who was there.
